@name: Gossip
@slug: gossip
@source: sohk
@category: RMFRP School of Hard Knocks
@default_cost: 18
@description:
 [Vocational] A gossip is adept at gathering information and then conveying it
 to others in the form of stories and tales. Gossips often know several
 incriminating facts about their neighbors and friends and they seldom keep
 these facts to themselves. Often a gossip won't even need to hear anything
 worth repeating, they'll make it up as long as they have an audience.
 Sometimes a gossip will overhear a tale that is just too good to share (like
 the location of buried treasure), but they usually cannot resist telling
 “just a few people”. Time to Acquire: 22 months. Starting Money: normal.

# Random outfitting roll: <chance%> | <item description>. Each row is rolled independently.
@specials:
30 | Useful contacts with local innkeeper

40 | Embarrassing secret (about someone else)
30 | Valuable secret (about someone else)
40 | Reputation as a gossip
100 | Large bar tab at local tavern
